snippet.title: [GBC] Macross 7: Ginga no Heart o Furuwa Sero!! マクロス7 -銀河のハートを奮わせろ!!- Walkthrough
snippet.description:
Developer(s) Gamates, Aisystem Tokyo
Publisher(s) Epoch Co.
Platform(s) Game Boy Color(Color only)
Release:  March 17, 2000(JP)

" Macross 7: Ginga No Heart Wo Furuwasero!! " (マクロス7 -銀河のハートを奪わせろ!!-) is an Action Shooting + Rhythm Game for the Game Boy Color developed by Gamates with I-System Tokyo and published by Epoch. The game was released in Japan in the year 2000. The Macross 7 fleet has run into what appears to be an inhabitable planet. Reconnaisance units were sent to investigate, but none of them returned. Meanwhile, Basara of Fire Bomber decides to launch, seeking a new audience for his passionate songs. Suspecting that the planet is not what it seems, Mylene, Ray, Veffidas, Gamurin, Captain Max & Mayor Millia decide to follow him.

◆Time Stamp
●Intro 00:00
●Stage1 Boss (♪ PLANET DANCE) 6:20
●Stage2 Boss (♪ SEVENTH MOON) 10:22
●Stage3 Boss (♪ DYNAMITE EXPLOSION) 14:30
●Stage4 Boss (♪ HOLY LONELY LIGHT) 18:06
●Stage5 Boss (♪ NEW FRONTIER) 22:36
●Stage6 Boss (♪ TRY AGAIN) 28:35
●Ending (♪ Totsugeki Love Heart) 33:25 

Played by seabook
